shape.description: sequence of integers, describing the shape of the output array.
constraints: shape must be a sequence of integers describing the shape of the output array.

fill_value.description: the value to fill the new array with. dtype: the type of the output array, or `None`. If not `None`, `fill_value` will be cast to `dtype`.
constraints: fill_value can be of any type.

sharding.description: an optional sharding specification for the resulting array, note, sharding will currently be ignored in jitted mode, this might change in the future.
constraints: must be an optional sharding specification
sharding is an optional sharding specification for the resulting array.

output.description: Returns an array of `shape` filled with `fill_value`.
